description: Product webhook handlers currently have no retry or failure tracking. If a webhook fires during a sync error the event is silently lost. Add: (1) retry wrapper in the webhook handler with exponential backoff, (2) write failures to SyncState.errorLog with timestamp and event payload, (3) surface missed-event warnings in the status dashboard. Consider rate limiting if Wix fires many events in a burst.
title: Webhook reliability: retry logic + dead-letter handling
